name: Accordion Gallery
description: Horizontal row of tall image strips with staggered vertical offsets. Hovering a strip expands it while the others stay narrow and fade back.
contents: Row of image cards with rounded corners and staggered top offsets
behavior: Hovered card expands its width smoothly while others shrink and dim
Leaving the row restores all cards to equal width and full opacity
Card height switches between mobile and desktop values below 768px width
editableByProps: Images, alt text and number of cards
Expanded width, transition speed, dimmed opacity
fixed: Renders nothing until mounted on the client
Mobile card height is decided once at render using a 768px width check
